findings.reason: §10 should be dropped or closed as already-landed so no implement node is dispatched to re-delete machinery that is gone, and the section's budget is freed.
findings.text: §10 plans to delete `_slurm_service_uri` and the SLURM branch of `_resolve_graph_uri` as duplicates of `profiles.py`, but neither exists: `git grep _slurm_service_uri -- imas_codex tests` returns nothing, `_resolve_graph_uri` is a one-line delegation to `get_graph_uri()`, and §10's own done-when (`rg '_slurm_service_uri|discover_compute_node_local|_resolve_compute_host' imas_codex/graph`) is already empty — the deletion landed in `30597f737`, an ancestor of HEAD and newer than the plan's last listed commit `4a30fab9d`.

findings.reason: the section must name the scorer call site that invokes the rule (or the mark is dead in the scan pipeline), rather than asserting the scorer gains a rule it never calls.
findings.text: §3(b) states "the wiki scorer gains a dynamic-page rule", but `apply_dynamic_page_rule` has no production call site anywhere in `imas_codex/` and the existing scorer `_score_pages_heuristic` (`imas_codex/discovery/wiki/scoring.py:961`) is not extended or invoked; the rule is operator-invoked only, so the `fronts_database` mark never applies during a scan.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan adds no module; §9 condenses three DataAccess write sites behind one `persist_data_access(data_access)` function, adding depth rather than surface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the plan names the owners it extends rather than forking them: the EDAS scanner and `enumerate_edas.py` for the PID pass (§3c), `link_chunks_to_entities` for the DOCUMENTS merge (§3a), `resolve_service_url` through the profile layer (§10).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 names its retiral (the prototype `class:`/`shots:`/`udpid:` keyword parking), §3 states `fronts_database` retires nothing and why, and §9/§10 add no CLI, MCP-view or refusal surface.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §10 proposes deleting `imas_codex/graph/client.py::_slurm_service_uri` and the SLURM branch of `_resolve_graph_uri`, both of which are already absent from HEAD.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §3(b) says the wiki scorer gains a dynamic-page rule, but the landed `apply_dynamic_page_rule` has no production call site and the existing scorer is not named as the extension point.
